payload.text: kovacs is brew-only for Utilz and Intent (hv, 19 Oct): Utilz 2.14.1 from the tap since 20 Oct (dc's readback, 81 ok), with no dev checkout and no link into one. A test leg lives in its own /var/tmp run dir, ships its own tree, and is removed once its logs are back. Its cargo legs put ~/.cargo/bin first (rustup stable 1.99.1, CI's toolchain, with clippy and rustfmt), since brew's rust comes first on PATH. Nothing for acceptance (xvfb, a browser, node) is installed. A fresh Homebrew 7 needs brew trust matthewsinclair/utilz between the tap and the install. kovacs-sysadm is reachable only while this session is on Remote Control, and it acts at hv's approval in its own session.
